name: ZYNP Corporation
summary: ZYNP Corporation engages in the research, development, manufacture, and sales of automotive components in China and internationally. The company offers cylinder liners for the passenger car, commercial vehicle, construction machinery, agricultural machinery, shipbuilding, garden machinery, air compressor, and other power fields. It also offers engine parts, automotive electronics, driving products, and equipment. The company was founded in 1958 and is headquartered in Mengzhou, China.
